The kitchen produces daily lunch and dinner specials alongside a full menu of classic Italian dishes, and the restaurant's party room accommodates up to 100 guests for private occasions. blocks.html: The North Arlington section of Riverside County Park stretches along Riverside Avenue with more than four miles of biking and walking paths, a Passaic River lookout point, pickleball and tennis courts, baseball and softball fields, multipurpose athletic fields, a track, an amphitheater, and a Rowing Center operated in partnership with the Passaic River Rowing Association. blocks.title: Sawmill Creek & Transco Trails
blocks.html: The Sawmill Creek Trail and Transco Trail are part of the New Jersey Sports and Exposition Authority's Meadowlands District park system, offering a combined stretch of trail through one of the region’s most ecologically significant wetland environments. The Sawmill Creek Trail leads visitors to the vast tidal mudflats of the Sawmill Creek Wildlife Management Area, while the 1.2-mile Transco Trail runs alongside tidal wetlands with wide-open views and excellent wildlife-watching opportunities, particularly for shorebirds and migratory species.

items.q: What age do you need to be to receive cannabis delivery in North Arlington?
items.a_html: New Jersey law sets the adult-use minimum at 21, and that applies to every Lady L delivery order without exception. Age is verified during account registration, and your driver will confirm your ID again upon arrival.

items.q: What ID is needed to complete a delivery?
items.a_html: A valid government-issued photo ID is required at two points in the process: uploaded to your Lady L account before your first order, and presented in person when your driver arrives. Driver's licenses, state-issued IDs, and passports all qualify. Out-of-state IDs are accepted.

items.q: Is a medical cannabis card required to place a delivery order?
items.a_html: No medical card is necessary. Lady L is an adult-use cannabis microdispensary, which means any customer 21 or older can place a delivery order with a valid ID and a confirmed account. Nothing else is required.

items.q: What’s the purchase limit for a North Arlington delivery order?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law permits us to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams, or one ounce, of usable cannabis per transaction. Here's how that breaks down across product types:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What taxes apply to a North Arlington cannabis delivery order?
items.a_html: New Jersey adult-use cannabis carries a 6.625% state sales tax, a $2.50-per-ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF), and a 2% municipal transfer or user tax where applicable. Every tax is itemized at checkout before you confirm, so there are no surprises when your order goes through.
